high_level_description: The image is a news report from Fox News Channel about an FBI operation in Michigan. The top portion of the image contains text that reads: "FBI Director Kash Patel says his agents 'thwarted a potential terrorist attack and arrested multiple suspects in Michigan.' The suspects were allegedly plotting a violent attack over Halloween weekend." Below the text, there is a photograph of a man standing in front of the FBI seal. The man appears to be a man of South Asian descent with short dark hair and a beard. He is wearing a dark jacket over a white shirt.
